The '''Verpine headband''' was a headband designed by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. The headband was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetic]] construct used to force its wearers to maintain focus by striking them with electrical shocks should their attention waver. This allowed a boost in mental abilities, but the crudity of this method was a cause for concern for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Nevertheless, the Verpine were free to manufacture them as they were not subject to the Republic's regulations regarding such equipment.

The headbands saw use during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. While most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] could wear them, they were not compatible with the frame of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] head.
